jobs.name: marko-death
jobs.prompt: Game sprite animation for marko, identity and detailed painted costume EXACTLY as reference. SIX separate sequential full-body DEFEAT / DEATH poses in ONE horizontal strip on solid pure #00FF00 chroma green. Character initially faces RIGHT and collapses backward toward LEFT. Non-graphic, no blood. Frame1 struck torso leaning back, knees buckle. Frame2 drops to one knee, head lowered. Frame3 both knees down, hand reaches ground to left. Frame4 tips sideways, hip hits ground. Frame5 lying on back/side, legs settling. Frame6 completely motionless on side on ground, eyes closed, weapon resting beside body. Same anatomical head size and limb lengths ALL SIX poses, do NOT enlarge lying poses. Common ground baseline. Entire character, cape, weapon(s) visible within each separated pose, generous green space between poses and outer edges. No shadow, floor, dust, glow, lettering, panels or guides. Crisp painterly cel shaded rendering matched to reference. Very wide landscape row, grounded believable collapse. Preserve red cloak and spiked mace.

jobs.name: marko-crouch
jobs.prompt: Production 2D game animation of Marko Kraljevic EXACT reference identity, red gold embroidered cloak, moustache, leather armor, ivory sleeves, SPIKED MACE. SIX separate successive full-body poses in ONE horizontal row, facing RIGHT, pure flat #00FF00 green chroma background. Frame1 standing alert with mace across waist. Frame2 lowers hips knees bent. Frame3 deep defensive crouch thighs near horizontal, head low, mace held close. Frame4 same low crouch weight forward, head remains low. Frame5 rises halfway. Frame6 returns standing. Boots planted, crouch should genuinely reduce height by 40 percent without changing anatomy. Identical anatomical scale and head size across frames, shared foot baseline, ample padding and clear green separation. All weapons and cape fully inside each pose. Crisp detailed painterly cel-shaded style matching reference. No text, no ground, no shadows, no glow, no additional people.
